notes.title: Wild West Saloon Simulator v0.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] You can now check how much liquid remains in your bottles simply by looking at them.
[*] Bottles stored on shelves or in drawers will also display their liquid levels in real time.
[*] Dropping an item from your inventory now feels more realistic.
[*] Customer order waiting times have been increased by at least 50%.
[*] Order widgets from customers will now appear larger.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h1]

[list]
[b][u][*] Special lighting activation when entering buildings, which was causing crashes, has been removed. Existing lighting has been optimized and redesigned for better performance.[/u][/b]
[u][*] Several additional crash-related issues have been fixed.
[*] Background optimizations have been made to reduce CPU load, making the game more efficient compared to the previous version.
[*] Performance loss caused by lighting has been reduced.
[*] A huge thank you to Chuckmeister85 for providing invaluable support during the early stages and helping us identify bugs and improvements![/u] ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

notes.title: Wild West Saloon Simulator v0.1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]🆕 New Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a UI indicator showing how many drinks are left in barrels placed on the bar counter.
[*] When purchasing a horse, it will now spawn near the player on the map.
[*] NPCs will now exhibit more natural behavior.
[/list]

[h1]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing 'F' would not make the horse come to the player.
[*] Fixed crashes occurring during the game's startup sequence.
[*] Improved loading screens: instead of loading the entire game in a single frame, loading will now be distributed across multiple frames, increasing stability.
[/olist]
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Wild West Saloon Simulator 0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]

[/list]
[h2]
Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where customers would sometimes sit outside the bar.

[*]

[/list]
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Wild West Saloon Simulator v0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where players would spawn in the wrong location after exiting mining and horse racing events.
[*] Fixed the issue where notifications from the top-right corner of the screen would not fully disappear.
[*] Now, when a player reaches level 8 while mining, the mine expands with an explosion. (Previously, players had to exit and re-enter the game for the expansion to take effect.)
[*] Fixed the issue from version v0.1.1 where players couldn't open a bar due to tax-related problems.
[*] Various optimization improvements have been made.
[*] 
[/list]
[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]

[olist]
[*] The script responsible for transferring buildable items to the inventory when upgrading the bar may not work consistently. (In rare cases, not all items may be added to your inventory. We are working on a fix.)
[*] We are aware of feedback regarding customers running away without paying excessively. We will review this and release a balancing update soon.
[*] We are investigating reports of sudden FPS drops in certain situations. A major optimization patch is planned in the near future.
[/olist]
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Wild West Saloon Simulator v0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[u][b]Fixes & Adjustments:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 
[*] Fixed an issue where NPC customers would not leave after the bar closed.
[*] Increased the duration of an in-game day.
[*] Balanced NPC customer spawn values.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could pay taxes multiple times in the same day.
[*] Fixed button feedback issues in the mining market widget.
[*] Fixed a crash issue that occurred at the start of the game.
[*] Default graphics settings have been lowered to reduce initial system load when launching the game. (Your custom settings will still be applied; this change only affects the first launch.)
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues:[/u][/b]

[olist]
[*] [u]We are aware that some inventory interactions can cause item duplication or loss, and we are working on a fix.[/u]
[*] We are still investigating an issue where some orders do not visually disappear. We aim to fix this in the next patch. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Wild West Saloon Simulator v0.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Updates & Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] NPC customers now function much more stably.
[*] The number of customers arriving is now more balanced.
[*] Fixed visual glitches on some NPCs.
[*] Fixed an issue where, after skipping a day, customers couldn't find or ignored chairs the next day.
[*] Fixed some corrupted sound files in the main menu.
[*] Significantly reduced loading screen durations.
[*] Increased visual variety in loading screens.
[*] Fixed a bug in the tutorial that caused the game to restart from the beginning. (Previously, sleeping while the tutorial sequence was active would restart the game.)
[*] Fixed an issue where some in-game items were returning incorrect data to the player.
[*] Players can no longer skip the first day before completing the tutorial. The sleep event has been moved to the end of the tutorial.
[/list]
[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
[olist]
[*] Some ordered items still do not visually disappear.
[*] We are aware of the feedback regarding day length and are currently evaluating this.
[*] We are aware of certain inventory-related issues and are actively working on them.
[*] We are continuing to work on fixing the issues mentioned above in the next update. Please don’t forget to report any bugs you encounter or suggest changes you'd like to see!
[/olist]

Thank you for your support! Stay tuned... 🚀
